name: @daobrew/wellness-mcp
description: Wellness MCP server — biometric stress detection & recovery for AI agents

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for(const [source,output] of [['src/setup-cli.js','dist/src/setup-cli.js'],['src/cli-anchor-enrollment.js','dist/src/cli-anchor-enrollment.js']]){const entry=fs.lstatSync(source);if(!entry.isFile()||entry.isSymbolicLink())throw new Error(source+' must be a regular file');fs.copyFileSync(source,output)}for(const file of ['dist/src/setup-cli.js','dist/src/index.js','dist/src/engine/run.js']){const built=fs.lstatSync(file);if(!built.isFile()||built.isSymbolicLink())throw new Error('built CLI must be a regular file: '+file);fs.chmodSync(file,0o755)}"
